items.objective: Choose a useful phrase for asking someone to repeat an instruction.

prompt.text: You did not understand an instruction. What can you say?

options.label: Could you say that again, please?
options.feedback: This asks the person to repeat the instruction.

options.label: I understood everything.
options.feedback: This does not communicate that you need help understanding.

options.label: I will guess.
options.feedback: Ask for clarification when you do not understand an instruction.

items.explanation: Could you say that again, please? is one way to ask for repetition. Other polite reviewed phrases can also be appropriate.
